name: rolepod-seo
description: SEO + GEO + AEO site audit skills for AI coding agents — Quick/Full audit, 1–10 scores with quoted evidence, prioritized fix plan that hands off to rolepod-uiproof, rolepod-wplab and the rolepod parent roles. Skills only, no MCP server.

plugins.name: rolepod-seo
plugins.description: Four skills: /seo-audit (Quick or Full audit, 1–10 scores with quoted evidence, markdown report + JSON sidecar + self-contained HTML report with score cards and a colored priority matrix, published as the Artifact on Claude Code), /seo-fix-plan (findings → hand-offs per owner in dependency order, exact payloads for rolepod-wplab / frontend-developer / content-strategist), /seo-schema (JSON-LD per page type from facts on the page, required-property validation, placement hand-off), /seo-page-brief (intent, 40–60-word answer block, question headings, entities, schema, internal links — for content-strategist). Every finding quotes the page and the tag. Calls rolepod-uiproof for rendered-DOM / CWV when installed, hands WordPress writes to rolepod-wplab and copy to the rolepod content-strategist. No MCP server, no hooks.
